lesson.title: Reading Fluency: A Story with Pronouns and Plurals
lesson.subject: punjabi

contentBlocks.text: ਇਸ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੁਸੀਂ ਬਹੁਤ ਕੁਝ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ। ਅੱਜ ਇੱਕ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪੜ੍ਹੋ! (You've learned a lot this week. Today, read a whole story!)

Read this short story, built entirely from words you already know: ਮੈਂ ਖੇਡਦਾ ਹਾਂ। ਉਹ ਮੁੰਡੇ ਖੇਡਦੇ ਹਨ। ਉਹ ਕੁੜੀਆਂ ਖੇਡਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਬੱਚੇ ਕਿਤਾਬਾਂ ਪੜ੍ਹਦੇ ਹਨ। (I play. Those boys play. Those girls play. The children read books.) Read it aloud, then circle every pronoun (ਮੈਂ, ਉਹ) and underline every plural noun (ਮੁੰਡੇ, ਕੁੜੀਆਂ, ਬੱਚੇ, ਕਿਤਾਬਾਂ).
ਤੁਸੀਂ ਇੱਕ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਪੜ੍ਹੀ ਅਤੇ ਪੜਨਾਂਵ ਤੇ ਬਹੁਵਚਨ ਪਛਾਣੇ! (You just read a complete story and identified pronouns and plurals!) Tomorrow we'll review everything from this week.

objectives: Read a 4-sentence Gurmukhi story built entirely from this week's known vocabulary
Correctly identify every pronoun and plural noun within the story
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review this week's pronouns, plural nouns, and sentence-building.
2. Read the 4-sentence story together, pointing out that every word has already been taught.
3. Have the child read it aloud independently, circling pronouns and underlining plural nouns.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's cumulative review.
differentiationTips: Struggling: read each sentence together first, then have the child re-read it independently right after
Ready for more: ask the child to add one more sentence to the story using this week's vocabulary
This is the payoff moment for the whole week — celebrate that every single word in the story was already known before today
teacherGuide.answerKey: Pronouns: ਮੈਂ, ਉਹ (both instances). Plural nouns: ਮੁੰਡੇ, ਕੁੜੀਆਂ, ਬੱਚੇ, ਕਿਤਾਬਾਂ.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's 'reading fluency' goal, extending week 1's short story into a slightly longer one that adds pronouns and plurals.
